test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 3 March 2023)
subject: general
question:
Out of the following five figures, four are alike in some manner and one differs from these in that manner. Select the odd figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75fb8d1a7234bfb32e1fb82513c91605673114f18c619497109a854242db7bed.png]
solution:
Logic : In each figure according to the direction of arrows at one end of the line, at the other end half arrow is drawn to right hand side of the line.

So,

 
• Option - (1) :

** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c55aca0aac892741b6c2ddd9eaf8423e5bf1668d0b9097c2718f91d08f083841.png] **⇒ The half arrow is drawn to left hand side of the arrows at the other end of the line.**

 
• Option - (2) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f14e33df64ef5c363146a47f8a90322fad1c1df94b38310a61e05b7ee6b0cf9.png] ⇒ The half arrow is drawn to right hand side of the arrows at the other end of the line.

 
• Option - (3) : 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/682f1d2114ece5687108b1101af54ce2ec3a98f2cf66a59d36652eac8ff4aec4.png] ⇒ The half arrow is drawn to right hand side of the arrows at the other end of the line.

 
• Option - (4) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/277f3b06813d0262514dc9fed5616ef9fe81e363962a6fa8146c2b16fa2d25d7.png] ⇒ The half arrow is drawn to right hand side of the arrows at the other end of the line.

Here, Figure - (1) is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option - (1)" is the correct answer.
